## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking, fixes an issue)
- [ ] Feature (non-breaking, adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (API / types / exports)
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] Docs update
- [ ] Tests only
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling

## Scope

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm fmt:check` clean
- [ ] `pnpm lint:check` clean (zero warnings)
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` succeeds
- [ ] New behavior has tests; bug fixes have a regression test
- [ ] No TODO / FIXME added without a linked issue
- [ ] Exported types and public functions have JSDoc where behavior isn't obvious
- [ ] Docs updated if user-visible behavior or API surface changes
